'''One-Eye''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who was active during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Jedi" /> At some point, their right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was replaced with [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]], which also covered a large scar over the eye, rendering them a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]. They wore light [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and carried weapons such as an [[E-11 blaster rifle/Legends|E-11 blaster rifle]] and a [[Carbonite gun]]. One-Eye had brown eyes, light-colored skin, and brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]], except for their eyebrows, which were black.<ref name="Sith">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
One-Eye first appeared in the [[1997]] [[Star Wars video games|computer game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' as a character who only appeared in the game's multiplayer mode as a playable character model.<ref name="Jedi" /> They appeared again in ''Jedi Knight's'' expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''. ''Mysteries of the Sith'' introduced "multiplayer personalities", a form of character creation that put different character models under different professions. Each profession also had their own set of starting weapons for a match. One-Eye was categorized as a bounty hunter.<ref name="Sith" /> It is not known if One-Eye is meant to be the character's name or a nickname. Due to htheir multiplayer only appearances, One-Eye's place in [[canon]] is uncertain.
